hero.title: Eat well, <accent>live well.</accent>
hero.text: My role in public health is to promote healthy lifestyles by making nutrition science accessible. A nutrition graduate for over 25 years, I lead workshops and talks in French in Calgary and Southern Alberta.
hero.photoAlt: Céline Bossé, dietitian, smiling, wearing a scarf and an RD pin

profile.title: Supporting everyone, at every stage of life
profile.p1: I offer programs and workshops that help people eat better at every stage of life, while respecting each person’s cultural and social needs.
profile.p2: My work is designed for community organizations, schools and early childhood centres. My approach meets the needs of people of all ages while respecting everyone’s cultural background.

whoAmI.title: The French language and the art of cooking, always
whoAmI.p1: As a francophone living in a minority community, I have always carried a love of the French language and the art of cooking in my heart.
whoAmI.p2: As a mother of two and a young grandmother, my greatest joy is welcoming family and friends around a good meal. These moments of togetherness reflect my passion for cooking, my love of sharing, and my curiosity about the endless variety of fresh, unprocessed ingredients that can be combined to delight the taste buds.
whoAmI.p3: I quickly brought this passion into everyday life, offering reliable, evidence-based nutrition advice to individuals and communities. Because today, we know:

stats.title: Ten years of Ateliers cinq épices in Alberta
stats.text: Since 2015, little chefs have been handling, measuring, cutting and tasting. The results speak for themselves.

items.label: launched in Alberta with the ACFA régionale de Calgary

services.title: Four ways to put health on the menu
services.text: Community and educational programs that build a taste for healthy eating and share the joy of cooking.

items.title: Ateliers Cinq Épices
items.text: Every child handles, measures and cuts the food. By cooking and tasting, our little chefs discover new foods and build independence in the kitchen.

items.title: Community kitchens for sharing and learning
items.text: Small-group workshops to rebuild cooking skills: choosing ingredients, preparing and storing food. Healthy, affordable recipes ready in under 30 minutes.

items.title: Health promotion
items.text: Through quizzes and games, we review your eating habits and find solutions that fit your lifestyle, at every stage of life.

items.title: Health at school and at work
items.text: One-hour interactive sessions, Lunch & Learns, educational grocery store tours and talks to debunk nutrition claims and pack a better lunch box.

audience.title: People of all ages
audience.text: From toddlers to seniors, respecting everyone’s cultural needs. I work mainly in French.
